findings.fix: Remove the script internals the agent does not act on (scratch copy, signature check, list of parsed URL forms). Keep only the stdout contract, the PNG location, the -e embed fact and the failure meanings. The internals stay documented in README.md and the tests.

findings.evidence: "the same prose with an inline Mermaid block in place of the PNG reference (omit the diagram only when it has no Mermaid equivalent)"
findings.fix: Add a one-line decision rule for the fallback: flowcharts and sequence diagrams map to Mermaid flowchart or sequenceDiagram. Free-form layouts (network maps, UI mockups) get no Mermaid; use a one-sentence description of the diagram instead. That way the agent does not have to invent its own criterion.

findings.evidence: The description opens "Render draw.io diagrams to PNGs with the diagram embedded" but sets no boundary against rendering outside a PR, while trigger-queries.json expects "convert architecture.drawio to a transparent PNG for the slides" not to trigger
findings.fix: Use this skill to get a rendered draw.io diagram into a pull request body: render the .drawio to a PNG with the diagram embedded, attach it with gh --attach (github.com, gh 2.101+) or, on GitHub Enterprise or older gh, publish it to the single pr-diagrams branch. Also finds the merged source PRs a promotion PR (staging → production, develop → main) should reuse, copies their diagram image URLs and requests their human reviewers. Use when attaching or hosting a diagram image in a PR body, choosing where diagram images live, promoting a branch and reusing earlier PR diagrams or reviewers, even if the user never says "pr-diagrams". Not for exporting a .drawio to PNG/SVG outside a PR (slides, docs), drawing or editing draw.io XML (draw-io), creating a PR without a diagram, or listing reviewers already requested on a PR (gh pr view).

findings.evidence: 12 should-trigger vs 9 should-not-trigger queries; most are terse one-liners ("create a pull request", "draw a diagram of this module") with no file paths, PR numbers or personal context
findings.fix: Rebalance to about 10/10 and rewrite several queries with realistic context. Examples: "my manager wants the arch diagram in docs/arch.drawio to show up in PR #212 on our GHE instance" (should trigger) and "export docs/arch.drawio as SVG for the wiki page" (near-miss, should not trigger).

findings.evidence: "Request them with `gh pr edit "$N" --repo "$REPO" --add-reviewer <login>,...`" does not show how to turn the JSON array into the comma list, and there is no branch for an empty array `[]`
findings.fix: Add: `R=$(bash "$PRD" reviewers ... | jq -r 'join(",")')`, and run `gh pr edit "$N" --repo "$REPO" --add-reviewer "$R"` only when `$R` is non-empty. When it is empty, say that no human reviewers were found and skip the call.

findings.evidence: "`related` and `reviewers` support github.com only, so promotion reuse is unavailable on GHE." gives no next action
